adaptation.information_pattern: finite causal response: pursuer chooses from the current state, then evader observes that turn rate and responds before the next state is observed
adaptation.interpretation: source-derived finite game; not a reproduction of the continuous-action RL result
adaptation.objective_orientation: analysis adaptation: pursuer turn rate minimizes terminal Euclidean separation and evader heading maximizes it; source returns positive separation but does not specify per-agent payoff signs
adaptation.state_quantization: round each source RK4 outer update to the nearest 1e-6 lattice point

numerics.propagation: 10-step RK4 with held actions over each 0.1-second decision stage; state rounded once per stage

source_model.terminal_reward: positive euclidean_distance(pursuer_position, evader_position); source code does not encode per-agent payoff signs
